title: CPF Module Schema: Private DNS Resolver Inbound Endpoint module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-privatednsresolverinboundendpoint'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
module_name: Private DNS Resolver Inbound Endpoint module

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

ip_configurations.description: (Required) Multiple objects can be specified to define multiple IP configurations. object({ private_ip_allocation_method = (Required) Private IP address allocation method. Allowed value is Dynamic. Defaults to Dynamic. subnet_id = (Required) The subnet ID of the IP configuration. }))

private_dns_resolver_id.description: (Required) Specifies the ID of the Private DNS Resolver Inbound Endpoint. Changing this forces a new Private DNS Resolver Inbound Endpoint to be created.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The resource ID of the created private DNS resolver inbound endpoint.

name.description: The name of the created private DNS resolver inbound endpoint.

resource.description: The Private Dns Resolver Inbound Endpoint resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Privatednsresolverinboundendpoint' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
